title: Account
loginIntro: Sign in with an account on this server.
name: Display name
signupIntro: Verify your email address before signing in.
verifyIntro: Continue only if you created this account.
received: If the required conditions are met, instructions will be sent by email.
verified: Email verified. You can now sign in.
resetDone: Password updated. Return to the normal sign-in screen.
failed: The request could not be completed. Check your input and sign-in method.
unavailable: Accounts are unavailable. Check the server configuration.
disabled: Accounts are not enabled on this server.
closed: This server is not accepting new registrations.
empty: You have not joined a workspace.
boundary: Notes on this device are not automatically saved to this account or its workspaces.
privacy: Passwords and confirmation links are not included in locally saved data.
missingToken: This link cannot be used. Request new instructions.
deliveryNote: An instruction request does not confirm email delivery.
oauthFailed: External sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.
inviteSignIn: Sign in with the email address that received this invitation to review it.
inviteInvalid: This invitation link cannot be used. Open the original invitation email again or request a new invitation.
inviteMemory: Invitation details stay only in this page's memory. If you reload or leave, reopen the original invitation link.
inviteIntro: Review the invitation with a verified account, then explicitly accept it.
inviteEmailMatch: You can review only invitations addressed to your currently verified email.
inviteNeedsVerification: Verify this account's email address first.
inviteScopeUnknown: The destination and permissions stay hidden until review. Reviewing does not accept the invitation.
inviteSinglePage: One specified page only, excluding child pages
inviteConsent: I agree to join with the scope and permissions shown.
inviteUnavailable: The invitation could not be reviewed. Check the email address, expiry and inviter's current access.
inviteActorChanged: The signed-in account changed. Check your account, then reopen the original invitation link.
inviteAcceptUncertain: The acceptance result could not be confirmed. Check your joined workspaces. If retrying cannot use the invitation, request a new one.
inviteExternalNote: Leaving for external sign-in does not retain this invitation. After signing in, reopen the original invitation link.
localeFallbackNotice: Some labels use English. Page names and content are not translated.
